description: Use when your human needs help with something: health, fitness, beauty, home, money, career and more. Returns up to 5 AI pros that answer free, day or night, each with a link for your human. Pass api_key and every person who opens your links counts for you. No key needed to call it.

api_key.description: Your OpenMyPro agent key (omp_ak_ plus 32 hex). Optional when the connection already sends Authorization: Bearer.

category.description: Optional field, for example Health & Care or Money & Business

need.description: What your human needs, in plain words, for example "lower back pain" or "family budget"

name: find_pros
title: Find an AI pro for your human
